history.summary: NOT A HINDU TEMPLE ALONE - an interfaith religious complex in Tezu where a Hindu temple, a Buddhist monastery and a gurudwara stand vis-a-vis within a single compound, cited by the Lohit district administration as a living example of a pure secular society and communal harmony. Researched the same way as other rows; keep-or-drop decision needed. No founding date, deity names or festival details are documented in available sources; no on-topic photograph found after searching. Coordinates are Tezu town-level (approximate).

name: Temple (Tezu Temple-Monastery-Gurudwara Compound)
town_description: Tezu is one of the oldest towns of Arunachal Pradesh and the headquarters of Lohit district, set amid the Mishmi Hills in the east of the state. It is a gateway to eastern Arunachal's forests, rivers and tribal villages, and the district administration highlights its record of communal harmony and peace.

travel.airport: Dibrugarh (Mohanbari) airport, about 154 km away; a small airport (TEI) exists at Tezu
travel.railway: Tinsukia railway station, about 120 km away (Dibrugarh about 170 km)
travel.road: NH-52 (old numbering) connects Tezu to Tinsukia, Dibrugarh and Guwahati; government and private buses plus night super service from Guwahati; daily vehicles from Tinsukia
